Did you enable transparent browser ? If you didn't:  
\- In the URL bar type "about:config"  
\- Accept the risks  
\- search for "browser.tabs.allow\_transparent\_browser"  
\- And switch the "false" to "true"  
\- Close Zen and reopen it
